raw.query: WITH d AS (SELECT run_id, window_name, policy, lead_s, superseded_by FROM provenance.v_dim WHERE is_current = true AND superseded_by IS NULL AND window_name IN ('burst3','burst4')), p AS (SELECT * FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE is_current = true) SELECT d.window_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.run_id) AS current_runs, COUNT(*) AS latency_rows, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT d.lead_s ORDER BY d.lead_s) FILTER (WHERE d.lead_s IS NOT NULL) AS configured_lead_s, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.lead_s = 345) AS rows_with_345s_lead, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.lead_s = 1) AS rows_with_1s_lead, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT p.sla_metric ORDER BY p.sla_metric) AS available_metrics, MIN(p.p90_ms) AS min_p90_ms, MAX(p.p90_ms) AS max_p90_ms FROM d JOIN p USING (run_id) GROUP BY d.window_name ORDER BY d.window_name

Available metrics are encoder_delay, itl, and ttft.
